sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and expressly includes Saudi Arabia.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Saudi Arabia

sources.title: Visas to Jordan: Saudi Arabia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live site identifies itself as the official Jordan Tourism Board and its nationality table has a direct Saudi Arabia row.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Saudi Arabia | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival.

policies.title: Saudi ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Saudi Arabia in its no-visa-required list.
conditions: The Embassy page states a maximum stay of three months for the named no-visa-required cohort.
This covers ordinary Saudi passports and visitor travel only; passport validity, onward travel, funds, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Saudi ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board nationality table states that Saudi visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Jordan's current visitor guidance requires non-Jordanian travellers to obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Passport validity, purpose, permitted ports, security screening and final admission remain applicable; work, residence and special documents are outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Jordan's live official nationality table says the Saudi Arabia visa can be obtained on arrival; it does not state a visa exemption.
